results.name: Shipping combat exposes no QA mutation helpers
The 18 second intro cannot be skipped, shortened or fought during
Hidden tab time does not count as viewing the intro
Exactly two combatants, fixed knight and T-Rex, remain in the arena
Natural stationary AI respects 330px personal space through all phases
Holding movement cannot cross Rex, push his skull through knight, or leave bounds
Rex commits to his windup and strike position rather than tracking the player
Normal strike telegraph lasts at least one second before attack
Retreating from a telegraphed attack avoids damage without the Rex chasing
Rex responds to player attacks with defense; recovery creates a real damage window
Pause freezes HP, time and motion; resuming restores combat
Natural AI can be defeated using real keyboard events and readable timing
Dodge art offsets stay inside the physical arena at both walls
Idle, windup, attack, recovery and defensive art never overlap knight torso
Rex attack always provokes dodge or parry; exhausted defense can lose
Only Rex HP defeat awards victory; elapsed time cannot end the fight
